messages.subject: Loading data?
parts: How do I make it so users of my Shiny app can load data to be visualized?

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Loading data?
parts: Try the fileInput control, which will let users upload a file. It is "experimental" quality right now though, in particular it only works on Google Chrome I believe (possibly very recent versions of Firefox as well).

messages.author: 87cf4991b6a810ee
messages.subject: Re: Loading data?
parts: When you say Chrome do you actually mean webikit browsers or do you actually mean it wont work in Safari or webkit based mobile browsers?

On Friday, November 9, 2012 1:51:46 PM UTC-5, Joe Cheng [RStudio] wrote:
Try the fileInput control, which will let users upload a file. It is "experimental" quality right now though, in particular it only works on Google Chrome I believe (possibly very recent versions of Firefox as well).

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Loading data?
parts:
Actually I just tested and it works in Safari 6, but not Safari 5; and it also works in Firefox 15. We're using some pretty recent features of HTML5 File API and they have only recently landed in these browsers. In fact I think this might be the list of supported browsers:
http://caniuse.com/#feat=filereader

Re: Webkit based mobile browsers, I only have access to iOS devices and they don't have a traditional filesystem (in theory you could upload a photo from your camera roll, I don't know why that wouldn't work).

I just looked at ?fileInput and it is strangely missing the info you need to actually retrieve the data. You can try this gist[0], which not only demonstrates the fileInput call but also shows you what the contents of the input$<fileInput-input-id> data frame looks like. It is one row per file (multiple files are an optional feature) and the columns are name (original filename), size, type (MIME type as a string), and datapath (a temp file that contains the actual binary contents of the uploaded file).

[0] https://gist.github.com/4050398
